assassinInfiltration.rule: Advance by significant tower disruption/ascent, not invented minutes: following party -> using distraction -> climbing Level 5 windows -> in Merilla's chamber.

merillaWake.rule: While the Faerie Dragon can act, apply the source 5% per-round chance to wake Merilla.

truth: Merilla is a lawful retired hero; tower is silent; powerful items are rumoured.
nodes.freeText: Allow another source-appropriate hook and record its legal/moral authority.

truth: Reading the east-door runes triggers a 10d6 fireball, save half under native rules.
nodes.freeText: Reading is the trigger. Exceptional climbing/flight may reach the only windows at Level 5 if supported by rules/geometry.

truth: Bronze Golem protects a 30-foot radius around itself/worktable; Carpet Trapper triggers at centre; two Rust Monsters roam; central stairs lead up.
nodes.freeText: Release 21 gives no old random potion/scroll percentages. Respect specific guardian triggers and no-magical-aura component text.

truth: North/southwest chests each hold 15,000 gp and are fireball trapped; southeast chest is a Morphganger; Platemail of Life Protection +3 with six charges hangs on south wall.
nodes.freeText: Preserve exact chest identities/traps and Release 21 armour placement/charge state.

truth: Faerie Dragon is mentally linked to Merilla and tries to wake her; this floor is a relaxation/meditation area.

choices.label: Let the dragon try to wake Merilla

nodes.freeText: Persist any successful Merilla wake state through the finale.

truth: Two Pipe Beasts guard the stairs and are determined to stop anyone except Merilla from ascending.

choices.label: Use magic/stealth/mobility to bypass the guarded area

nodes.freeText: Use Release 21 Pipe Beast behaviour: claws/tail or acid cone, fire immunity, guard-until-threat-destroyed. Do not use old Blast Spores.

truth: Two external assassins used party distraction to enter through the only windows and intend to murder Merilla.
nodes.freeText: Assassin employer is source-unspecified. Use current Merilla wake state.

truth: Merilla survives; rescue-related guardian losses are forgiven; reward is 2,500 gp each plus a minor magic item.

choices.label: Return stolen property and accept reward

nodes.freeText: Rescue forgiveness covers rescue-related guardian damage, not blanket theft.

truth: If Merilla dies the rescue reward is gone and lawful/political consequences remain.
nodes.freeText: Do not revive Merilla off-screen or award the rescue reward.
